claims.statement: The official Clean Air materials state that the remaining prefinanced subsidy is paid after the contracted work is completed and a complete, correct payment application with required documents reaches the regional fund.
NFOŚiGW has publicly described actions intended to improve and accelerate handling of contractor-related payment applications, indicating that processing speed has been an operational concern.

contrary_evidence: The programme describes a 30-day payment target for a complete and correct application, which may be too short to justify a meaningful discount for many contractors.
Official prefinancing already sends part of the grant directly to contractors in eligible cases, reducing the addressable cash gap.

economics.acquisition_route: Accountant and wholesaler referrals to a tightly screened pilot, followed by integrations with contractor workflow tools
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A plausible 5-7 year path would require approximately 300 million PLN annual verified volume at about 0.8% retained platform revenue, low fraud losses borne under clear contracts, and expansion to adjacent renovation receivables while retaining founder equity
economics.founder_time: Approximately 10-15 hours per week if credit policy, collections, and regulated activity remain with partners
economics.gross_margin_basis: Origination, verification, and servicing revenue net of document review and fraud controls; funding capital and credit losses remain with a regulated partner
economics.payback: The discount is rational only when earlier cash enables profitable additional work or replaces costlier working capital; this needs contractor-level cash-cycle evidence
economics.pricing: Target a 2-4% all-in contractor discount for short-duration advances, with 0.5-1.0 percentage point retained by the platform plus a 200-400 PLN verification fee
economics.retention_or_repeat: Active contractors submit repeated projects and funders can reuse performance history

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A dataset linking document defects, regional fund processing, contractor behaviour, and payment timing could improve acceptance prediction and funding terms
fingerprint.customer: Vetted Polish heat-pump, insulation, window, and other thermomodernisation contractors participating in Clean Air projects
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Acquire through installer accountants, programme advisers, wholesalers, and a narrow pilot with contractors known to the family renewable business
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Document completeness checks, fraud flags, receivable status monitoring, and funder origination; earn an origination and servicing share without lending from the founder's balance sheet
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The contractor pays a 2-4% discount when the funding partner advances cash against a verified, eligible payment packet
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Work and documents are complete but the contractor waits for the remaining programme payment and needs working capital for the next installation

founder_fit: The founder understands finance and can build document-risk and payment-time models
The family business can help map the real contractor cash cycle without committing capital
A partner-funded structure respects the founder's limited capital and part-time constraint
risks: Subsidy receivables may be non-assignable or paid only to a specified beneficiary or contractor account
Incomplete, fraudulent, corrected, or clawed-back applications could create losses and disputes
Regulated credit intermediation rules may apply even without balance-sheet lending
Programme changes could abruptly alter volumes and eligibility

structure.control_point: The completeness certificate and, where lawful, assignment or controlled payment instruction for a specific accepted subsidy receivable
structure.critical_dependency: The programme receivable or payment direction must be legally financeable, and an external funder must accept the verification and counterparty risk

thesis: A partner-funded receivables bridge for vetted Polish thermomodernisation contractors could advance part of an expected Clean Air programme payment only after a completeness engine verifies the acceptance protocol, invoice, beneficiary contribution, and application packet. The founder would operate verification and origination, while a licensed lender or fund bears credit and liquidity risk.
title: Clean Air Claim Bridge
uncertainties: Current legal assignability and payment-direction rules for each Clean Air funding path
Actual distribution of complete-to-payment times after the 2025-2026 programme changes
Funder appetite and required first-loss protection
Contractor willingness to pay when official processing works within its stated timetable
